title: Tech News You Need Today

slides.headline: Tech News You Need Today
slides.subtitle: From data breaches to AI power struggles, here is the day's top tech news.

slides.headline: Social media giants face addiction lawsuits
slides.explanation: Courts have rejected appeals from Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Google regarding addiction lawsuits. This keeps thousands of cases against these platforms moving forward.

slides.headline: Massive shipping data breach hits everyone
slides.explanation: A cyberattack on Ceva Logistics has exposed personal data across banks, retailers, and even Steam gamers. If you shop online, your information may have been caught in the crossfire.

slides.headline: OpenAI pauses Astra over safety fears
slides.explanation: OpenAI slowed development of its Astra model because they could not rule out potential cyber risks. It shows how even the biggest AI labs are struggling to balance speed with safety.

slides.headline: Amazon's new power plant sparks climate debate
slides.explanation: Amazon is backing an off-the-grid power plant to support its data centers. Critics worry this move could become a major source of climate pollution in the race for AI dominance.

slides.headline: OpenAI finishes massive $7B employee payout
slides.explanation: OpenAI just wrapped up a tender offer that allowed employees to cash out $7 billion in shares. This kind of wealth moves local economies, like the housing market in San Francisco.

caption:
From major legal battles to the hidden costs of our AI obsession, the tech industry is moving fast today.

title: Politics and Crises Around the Globe

slides.headline: Politics and Crises Around the Globe
slides.subtitle: Five stories you need to know today.

slides.headline: NC Republicans Pick New Candidate
slides.explanation: Lawmaker Jennifer Balkcom will now run for North Carolina’s 11th district seat. This follows the incumbent dropping out after a House investigation into sexual harassment allegations.

slides.headline: Tanker Spill Off Oman Coast
slides.explanation: Oman is working to manage a major oil spill from a tanker linked to Russia’s shadow fleet. These vessels often operate outside regular channels to bypass international sanctions.

slides.headline: Tensions Rise at India Job Protests
slides.explanation: Police used teargas on protesters in India who claim there were irregularities in civil service recruitment exams. Young job seekers are frustrated by a system they say is unfair.

slides.headline: Hunger Striker Details Force Feeding
slides.explanation: A filmmaker in US immigration detention says he was force-fed during an eight-month hunger strike. He describes the experience as deeply harmful and traumatizing.

slides.headline: Ohio Rep Stays in Race Despite Claims
slides.explanation: Representative Max Miller is remaining on the ballot for his Ohio congressional seat despite facing domestic abuse allegations. The deadline to replace him has already passed.
